## v0.12.1

### Fixes

- **Windows:** Child processes (terminals, git, and other spawned tools) are now managed with a job object, so they are cleaned up when Vireo exits instead of lingering in the background. (`8837fe3`)
- **Shortcuts page:** Layout now scales correctly on wide screens. (`9fb3d08`)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Cosmos-0118/vireo/compare/v0.12.0...v0.12.1
